name: Andres Bonifacio
lore: Father of the Philippine Revolution and founder of the Katipunan. A man of the people who rose from poverty to lead a nation's fight for freedom. His rallying cry united millions against colonial rule.

abilities.name: People's Spirit
abilities.description: When any allied unit dies near Bonifacio (within 200 tiles), he gains +5% attack and +5% move speed, stacking up to 10 times.

abilities.name: Katipunan Rally
abilities.description: Instantly spawns 4 Rifleman units at Bonifacio's position. These units last 30 seconds.

abilities.name: Cry of Pugad Lawin
abilities.description: Bonifacio lets out a battle cry. All enemies within 250 tiles flee (move away from Bonifacio) for 5 seconds. Allied units in range gain full HP restoration.
